questions.question: What is the unit of Thermodynamic temperature?
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• The temperature is usually measured with a thermometer which is marked in several temperature scales mainly Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin.
 
• The SI unit of temperature as per the International System of Units is Kelvin which is represented by the symbol K.

EXPLANATION__:

__
 
• The kelvin (k) is the SI unit of temperature.
 
• The kelvin is defined as the fraction 1/273.16 of the thermodynamic temperature of the triple point of water.

questions.question: Which of the following is found in Tropical Deciduous Forests?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Tropical Deciduous Forests or Monsoon forests are the most common forests in India.
 
• Important trees of tropical deciduous forests include **shisam, mahua, sal, teak, and bamboo**__.
 
• Moist deciduous and dry deciduous forests are the two major categories of these forests.
 
• Shisham, mulberry, pine, babul, eucalyptus, and kikar are found in deciduous, dry, thorny forests.

questions.question: Which of the following is peninsular river?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Narmada river is one of the three major rivers in peninsular India **__that run from east to west along with Tapti River and the Mahi River.
 
• It is one of the rivers in India that flows in the rift valley, flowing west between the Satpura and Vindhya ranges.
 
• So, Narmada river of peninsular India is distinct from the remaining three in the above rivers.

questions.question: Which of the following stands at the top of the integrated judicial system in India?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Decisions made by the **Supreme Court of India are binding on all other courts in India**__.
 
• The Supreme Court of India is the __**highest judicial forum**__ under India’s constitution.
 
• It has the power of constitutional review.
 
• It consists of the Chief Justice of India and 30 other judges.
 
• It has extensive powers in the form of original, appellate and advisory jurisdictions.
 
• It takes up appeals mainly against verdicts of the high courts of various states of the Union and other courts and tribunals.
 
• The law declared by the Supreme Court becomes binding on all courts within India.

questions.question: The western part of the central highlands is known as the:
questions.solution:
__
 
• The western part of the central highlands is known as the** Malwa plateau**__.
 
• The Malwa plateau, the Aravallis, and a few parts of the Vindhya range form the norther central highlands.
 
• The Deccan plateau covers southern and western India.
 
• The Chota Nagpur plateau is the eastern plateau which covers Odisha, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Bihar and West Bengal.

questions.question: Alexander’s Indian invasion occurred in the year?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Alexander Invaded India in the year **326 BC.**__
 
• He fought the battle of Hydaspus against king Porus on the banks of River Jhelum
 
• Alexander remained in India for 19 Months.
 
• He marched towards India through the Khyber Pass.
